summary: Orbit (dashboard/desktop) now styles the operation sections: each orbit-act item is a bordered row whose left edge carries the activity colour (accent for active, bad for blocked, warn for stale/unknown, muted for registered/inactive), with orbit-activity and orbit-context lines set smaller. Only existing theme tokens are used, so light and dark follow the same palette. Account-usage reset rows more than 24 h after nowMs show the UTC weekday, day, month and time, e.g. 'Sat 21 Nov 23:00 UTC (in 3 d 11 h)'. Within 24 h (including exactly 24 h) and past resets keep the previous format. The format is computed from nowMs with UTC getters only (src/orbit.js resetText). Node tests cover the future, boundary and past cases, a month boundary, and that every activity kind has a stylesheet rule. Orbit stays read-only; no new dependencies. Synthetic data only; no network; nothing observed live.

commands.command: cd orchestrator && python -B -I -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_dev_orbit_view.py
